name: Strike Lab - Combat Training Arena
request: Create a small, playable Strike Lab fighting-game training arena for one player on desktop and touch. Include a humanoid training dummy, a three-hit light-attack combo with visible windup, contact and recovery animations, synchronized hit sound effects, a visible accepted-hit counter and dummy health. The server must validate attack timing and range. Each accepted strike damages and counts once at contact; swinging out of range, holding the button or spamming during recovery must not create extra hits. Show distinct hit and miss feedback. After defeat, reset the dummy and let the player practice again; provide a clear reset control and an uncluttered arena. Search Marketplace first for complete reusable combat/training components, compatible dummy rigs, existing animations and sound rather than rebuilding everything. Inspect compatibility, behavior and included media, preserve useful working pieces and author only missing integration. Source missing audio from Marketplace and verify actual playing animations and audible sounds. Record an importer capability gap honestly rather than treating it as a bad asset. Choose reasonable styling and damage values yourself. No PvP, matchmaking, saving, monetization or large world. Success needs native evidence for the full combo, exact counting, misses, recovery spam, defeat/reset and desktop/touch controls. A damage script with a static dummy does not meet the animation requirement.

assetNeeds.constraints: Humanoid character rig with unanchored limbs connected via Motor6D, HumanoidRootPart, and Humanoid for health tracking and hit reactions

intent.experienceRole: Provides a physical, responsive target for the player to practice 3-hit combo timing and range control.
intent.interaction: Player approaches the dummy and performs attacks; dummy takes damage on contact, flashes on hit, and resets on defeat or manual trigger.

assetNeeds.role: Impact sound effect for accepted strikes
assetNeeds.constraints: Crisp, snappy physical punch/kick impact sound under 1.5 seconds

intent.experienceRole: Delivers immediate tactile confirmation when an attack lands within range and valid timing.
intent.interaction: Plays at contact point when server validates an accepted strike.

assetNeeds.role: Whoosh sound effect for missed or out-of-range strikes
assetNeeds.constraints: Quick air-whoosh swing sound under 1 second

intent.experienceRole: Audible feedback for swinging out of range or spamming during recovery.
intent.interaction: Plays whenever an attack executes but misses or is blocked by recovery lockout.

spec.assetStrategy: Search Marketplace first for complete training dummy rigs, combat sound effects (punches, whooshes, impacts, defeat sounds), and combat animations. If imported animations or rigs have format limitations, provide reliable rigged joint animation routines and visual tweening for attack windup, contact extension, and recovery transitions so that every strike has distinct visual anticipation, contact, and recovery phases. All audio assets are sourced from Marketplace queries and verified.
spec.title: Strike Lab - Combat Training Arena
spec.summary:
Strike Lab is a focused, responsive fighting-game training arena designed for single-player practice on desktop and mobile touchscreen devices. Upon spawning inside a sleek, uncluttered neo-dojo training octagonal ring, the player faces a rigged humanoid Training Dummy stationed on a marked central sparring mat. The player initiates a 3-hit light-attack martial arts combo (Jab -> Cross -> Roundhouse/Hook). Each attack progresses through three distinct states: Windup (anticipation), Active/Contact (damage/hit validation frame), and Recovery (lockout before the next combo step or idle reset).

The server authoritatively validates each strike's timing, distance, and player combat state. Only hits that connect within range during the active contact window trigger dummy damage, increment the accepted-hit counter, play synchronized impact audio, and spawn impact visual effects. Out-of-range swings, holding the attack button, or spamming inputs during recovery or cooldown windows produce distinct miss/whoosh feedback and are strictly prevented from registering hits or dealing damage. When the dummy's health is depleted, it triggers a defeat reaction, awards combo completion feedback, and automatically respawns after a brief reset delay. The player can also trigger an immediate manual arena reset via a dedicated UI button. Desktop controls support primary mouse click or key press (F/J), while touch devices provide an ergonomic on-screen Strike button and Reset control.
spec.visualDirection: A modern, high-clarity neo-dojo training laboratory with minimalist geometric architecture. The arena floor features clean slate-grey polished concrete with glowing neon-cyan boundary trim and a dark rubber sparring mat with orientation markers in the center. Clean ambient studio lighting, soft overhead softbox lighting, and subtle bloom ensure high legibility of character silhouettes, attack windups, and recovery animations. Hit feedback features crisp floating damage numbers, neon spark burst particles, and momentary dummy hit-flash highlights. Misses display a subtle air-trail distortion and a muted 'MISS' indicator. The UI features a clean top-center dummy health bar with smooth lerping, a sharp accepted-hit counter and combo streak meter, and an uncluttered touch layout with rounded, high-contrast action buttons in the lower-right thumb zone.
